boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: No-purchase activities available to MSOE students or the public, with access conditions noted.

cards.title: Work out at the Kern Center Fitness Center
cards.subtitle: 1245 N. Broadway — MSOE students
cards.notes: Meet at the Fitness Center for a shared workout, then use the walk back to campus for a cooldown and catch-up.
cards.short_summary: A no-extra-cost fitness meetup for MSOE students.
cards.evidence_claim: MSOE lists a fitness center at the Kern Center and states that Kern Center membership is free for MSOE students.
cards.access_notes: MSOE students must present an MSOE ID. Membership is free for students; follow current facility guidelines.

cards.title: Walk the Kern Center running track
cards.subtitle: 1245 N. Broadway — MSOE students
cards.notes: Set an easy, conversational pace on the recreational running track for a weather-proof break between classes or study sessions.
cards.short_summary: An indoor walking hang using the Kern Center track.
cards.evidence_claim: MSOE lists a recreational running track at the Kern Center and states that Kern Center membership is free for MSOE students.
cards.access_notes: MSOE students must present an MSOE ID. Membership is free for students; check facility rules before using the track.

cards.title: Plan a Residence Life Cinema watch party
cards.subtitle: MSOE campus network — MSOE students
cards.notes: Pick a film or series available through Residence Life Cinema and arrange a campus-group viewing within the platform’s group-use terms.
cards.short_summary: A campus-network streaming option for a small group movie night.
cards.evidence_claim: MSOE states that Residence Life Cinema is available free to students on the university network and can be used by campus groups.
cards.access_notes: Available free to students accessing it on the university network. Campus groups may use it under MSOE’s stated viewing limits.

cards.title: Browse the Grohmann Museum
cards.subtitle: 1000 N. Broadway — MSOE students with ID
cards.notes: Bring your MSOE ID, take in the galleries at your own pace, and compare a few favorite works before heading back to campus.
cards.short_summary: An art-museum visit with free MSOE student admission.
cards.evidence_claim: The Grohmann Museum lists free admission for MSOE students with ID and identifies its location as 1000 N. Broadway.
cards.access_notes: Free for MSOE students with ID during posted gallery hours. Check the museum page for closures or special-event changes.

cards.entity_name: MSOE Raiders Men's Basketball Home Game
cards.title: Cheer at a Raiders men's basketball home game
cards.subtitle: Kern Center — MSOE students with valid ID
cards.notes: Check the Raiders schedule, meet before tipoff, and watch from the Kern Center stands with your valid MSOE ID.
cards.short_summary: A student-ticket-free way to watch Raiders basketball on campus.
cards.evidence_claim: MSOE Athletics lists men's basketball at the Kern Center and states that MSOE students receive free admission to home Kern Center events with valid ID.
cards.access_notes: Free for MSOE students with valid ID. Confirm the current home schedule and any postseason ticket policy before going.

cards.entity_name: MSOE Raiders Women's Volleyball Home Game
cards.title: Watch Raiders women's volleyball
cards.subtitle: Kern Center — MSOE students with valid ID
cards.notes: Use the official schedule to find a home match, arrive together, and follow venue staff directions from the student seating area.
cards.short_summary: A free-with-ID student outing for a home volleyball match.
cards.evidence_claim: MSOE Athletics lists women's volleyball among Kern Center home events and states that MSOE students receive free admission with valid ID.
cards.access_notes: Free for MSOE students with valid ID. Verify the official home schedule and any event-specific entry instructions.

cards.entity_name: MSOE Raiders Men's Soccer Home Game
cards.title: Catch a Raiders men's soccer match
cards.subtitle: Viets Field — MSOE students with valid ID
cards.notes: Choose a home date from the Raiders schedule, meet at Viets Field, and bring your MSOE ID for student entry.
cards.short_summary: A free-with-ID student spectator hang at Viets Field.
cards.evidence_claim: MSOE Athletics lists men's soccer at Viets Field and states that MSOE students receive free admission to Viets Field home events with valid ID.
cards.access_notes: Free for MSOE students with valid ID. Consult the official schedule for current dates, location, and weather updates.

cards.entity_name: MSOE Raiders Women's Lacrosse Home Game
cards.title: Watch Raiders women's lacrosse
cards.subtitle: Viets Field — MSOE students with valid ID
cards.notes: Coordinate around a home match at Viets Field, then stay through the final whistle for a straightforward outdoor group outing.
cards.short_summary: A no-ticket-cost student outing for a Raiders lacrosse game.
cards.evidence_claim: MSOE Athletics lists lacrosse at Viets Field and states that MSOE students receive free admission to Viets Field home events with valid ID.
cards.access_notes: Free for MSOE students with valid ID. Check the official athletics schedule before traveling to the field.

cards.title: Meet at Central Library
cards.subtitle: 814 W. Wisconsin Ave — public access
cards.notes: Take the walk downtown to browse, read together, or choose a listed program; leave time to explore the library’s historic spaces.
cards.short_summary: A public-library meetup with free programs and public spaces.
cards.evidence_claim: Milwaukee Public Library identifies Central Library at 814 W. Wisconsin Ave. and states that its programs are free and open to everyone.
cards.access_notes: Public library; programs are free and open to everyone. Check the Central branch listing for current hours and program details.

cards.title: Walk the Milwaukee RiverWalk
cards.subtitle: Downtown Milwaukee riverfront — public access
cards.notes: Start at a convenient downtown access point and take a slow riverfront walk, pausing at the public art and viewpoints along the route.
cards.short_summary: A free, always-open riverfront walk near campus.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Milwaukee states that the Milwaukee RiverWalk is open to the public 24 hours a day, 365 days a year, free of charge.
cards.access_notes: Open to the public 24 hours a day, 365 days a year, free of charge. Use normal nighttime awareness and follow posted conditions.
